title: IFS vs. BX: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
author: Na
description: In a comparison of two Financial - Miscellaneous Services sector stocks, Intercorp Financial Services Inc. (IFS) emerges as the more attractive option for value investors compared to Blackstone Inc. (BX). IFS holds a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) versus BX's #3 (Hold), and demonstrates superior valuation metrics including a forward P/E of 9.12 versus BX's 22.74, a PEG ratio of 0.73 versus 1.53, and a P/B ratio of 1.64 versus 4.8. IFS earned a Value grade of A while BX received a D grade.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: IFS demonstrates stronger fundamentals for value investors with a higher Zacks Rank (#2 Buy), significantly lower forward P/E ratio (9.12), lower PEG ratio (0.73), lower P/B ratio (1.64), and an A grade in the Value category, indicating it is more undervalued at current price levels.

BX shows weaker value metrics compared to IFS with a lower Zacks Rank (#3 Hold), higher forward P/E ratio (22.74), higher PEG ratio (1.53), higher P/B ratio (4.8), and a D grade in the Value category, making it less attractive for value investors.

title: Why Is Circle Internet Group, Inc. (CRCL) Up 63.1% Since Last Earnings Report?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) stock surged 63.1% following its Q2 2026 earnings beat, driven by strong USDC circulation growth (up 19% YoY to $73.3B), improved profitability (EPS of $0.18 vs. loss of $4.48 prior year), and expanded RLDC margins (41.2% vs. 38.2%). However, reserve income growth was tempered by lower interest rates. The company raised 2026 guidance for other revenues and RLDC margins, with Arc Mainnet launch scheduled for September 16, 2026. Despite the rally, Zacks assigned a Hold rating citing flat estimate revisions and a poor Value Score.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 earnings beat with 63.1% stock price appreciation, significant YoY growth in USDC circulation (19%), profitability improvement (EPS swing from -$4.48 to +$0.18), margin expansion, and raised 2026 guidance. Arc Mainnet launch catalyst upcoming. However, sentiment is tempered by interest rate headwinds and Zacks Hold rating.

Mentioned as industry peer with modest 3.2% monthly gain, solid revenue growth (+23.7% YoY), and stable EPS improvement. However, expected to face earnings decline (-10.5% YoY) in current quarter with flat estimate revisions. Assigned Zacks Hold rating.

title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Smartsheet Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
author: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman Llc
description: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Smartsheet Inc. alleging that company defendants made materially false and misleading statements and failed to disclose acquisition offers from Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners while conducting a $50 million share repurchase program. Investors who purchased Smartsheet securities between June 1, 2024 and September 23, 2024 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mentioned only as having made a credible acquisition offer for Smartsheet. No allegations or negative actions attributed to Blackstone; mentioned in factual context only.

title: Why Blackstone Inc. (BX) is a Top Stock for the Long-Term
author: Na
description: Zacks presents its Focus List investment strategy, a curated portfolio of 50 stocks designed to outperform the market over 12 months. The strategy relies on earnings estimate revisions and the proprietary Zacks Rank system. Historical performance shows the Focus List returned 2,519.23% cumulatively since 1996 versus the S&P 500's 854.95%. Blackstone Inc. is highlighted as a recent addition to the Focus List.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Added to Focus List at $120.89 with 18.49% share price increase to $143.24. Six analysts revised earnings estimates higher in last 60 days, consensus estimate increased to $5.99, and company boasts 13.9% average earnings surprise with expected 7.5% earnings growth for current fiscal year.

title: Nvidia Stock Soars After Q2 Earnings: Is NVDA Still a Buy?
author: Na
description: Nvidia surged 7% after delivering blockbuster Q2 earnings with $96.22B revenue (106% YoY growth) and raising FY28 guidance to ~70% growth. The Vera Rubin platform is ramping ahead of schedule with orders from all major hyperscalers. However, gross margins are expected to compress from 75% to 71-72% due to rising memory costs, and the company's massive capital commitments warrant monitoring.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Crushed Q2 expectations with 106% revenue growth, beat EPS estimates, provided strong Q3 guidance ($108B vs $102B consensus), and issued surprisingly bullish FY28 outlook (~70% growth). Vera Rubin platform ramping successfully. Stock trading at attractive 24X forward P/E, well below 10-year median of 45X.
